title: About KrishiMitra
subtitle: KrishiMitra was created with a single mission: to bridge the gap between agricultural scientific research and the everyday decisions of Indian farmers.

scientificRigor.title: Scientific Rigor
scientificRigor.desc: Every recommendation is grounded in verified ICAR packages of practices, Indian meteorological division guidelines, and Soil Health Card nutrient standards.

accessibility.title: Farmer-First Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Built mobile-first with high-contrast UI, multi-language support (English, Hindi, Assamese), and large touch targets designed for use directly on the field.

zeroHallucinations.title: Zero Hallucinations
zeroHallucinations.desc: Our AI assistant uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with verified citations and strict guardrails preventing fabrication of chemical dosages or pesticide advice.

mission.title: Alignment with Digital Agriculture Mission
mission.desc: KrishiMitra aligns directly with the Government of India's Digital Agriculture Mission, empowering smallholder farmers with open digital infrastructure, crop health monitoring, and direct price transparency to eliminate exploitative intermediary markups.
